read_convention: Every module file below was read in full, line1 through EOF, including imports, all comments, methods, setup/assertions/cleanup and metadata. Exact EOF and baseline-matching SHA256 are in local-reconciliation.json. IDs are candidate dispositions, not accepted edits or independent review verdicts.

api_reconciliation.generated_internal_exclusion: No separate prose demanded for extension grouping/duplicate spelling/implicit boilerplate; public members on internal constants/backends/initialization DTO are internal effective surface. Test/sample public types are nonshipping.

semantic_unit_rule: A complete member family, explanation paragraph/section, whole example, or assertion-backed test/helper is a unit. File-level candidate dispositions include all read members; targeted clean ranges below are independently meaningful units in otherwise affected files. Do not equate lines with units or count overlapping interface/concrete prose as separate findings.
